action.objective: Verify Kb1, the exact-depth-3 broad-search leader, to qualify a commit-ready move.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 ranked c2b1 top (exact -1050), but it lacks single-candidate verification and commit_ready is empty. In check, White's king must move; Kb1 walks away from the c-file rook/queen pressure. Verifying Kb1 uses the reserved 2000 nodes and checks mate-in-one and short tactical refutations. c2b2/c2d1 are bound=upper only, so their -1050 is not comparable and they stay unverified.
